verdict.rationale: Paxos documents AI assistance built into its documentation for contextual help with its APIs. That is a docs Q&A helper, not an assistant inside the platform or Dashboard that takes on and carries out tasks. The llms.txt and llms-full.txt files serve external AI tools and do not count as a built-in assistant. Missing for 10: an in-product (Dashboard/platform) AI assistant, the ability to delegate and execute tasks (e.g., transfers, orders, webhook setup) through it, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
